descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S06 「UAT 走查，养老院：同一个住户两次之前的就诊；每一条展开都是它自己那次就诊的文字」 UAT walk, Nursing Home: two prior visits on one resident; each expands to its own visit text

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 Entries display collapsed, each with a line count, and the line count is accurate.（UAT TC-16；TFA-92594 AC 3；TFA-92594 How it works 3）
  • U4 Expanding a collapsed entry shows the correct full transcript: that visit's lines for that patient, all of them, and nothing from another entry.（UAT TC-16；TFA-92594 AC 4；TFA-92594 How it works 4）
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, and passes in both.（UAT 3.3；TFA-92594 AC 2）
  • T2 Collapsed rows are labelled accurately (e.g. 'Most Recent'), so each row says which encounter it is.（TFA-92594 AC 3；TFA-92594 How it works 3）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given {snfResident} with two archived visit rows, as the lifecycle writes them ('<Mon D> · Visit notes', archivedAt set): one 7 days ago, one yesterday

When Open the resident's Encounter tab without opening anything; open the later visit; then open the earlier visit

Then Two collapsed rows, each '· Visit notes' with the visit text hidden. Each expands to its own visit's full text, and opening one closes the other. The line count and speaker shown are recorded

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs. cp1: mustContain '· Visit notes' and mustNotContain V1 and V2 (U3 collapsed, T2). cp2: mustContain V2, mustNotContain V1 (U4). cp3: mustContain V1, mustNotContain V2. mustNotContain {hospitalPatient} throughout (U8). The line count shown for dictated text (Q2) and the speaker label shown inside an opened row (Q4) are record-only (spec.manual), not judged, until Dan …
